title: Prime Subset Selection II
statement: The task is to choose distinct primes not exceeding n whose sum is as large as possible without exceeding s, breaking ties by fewest primes and then by the lexicographically smallest sorted list, with n and s up to 1000. It is a 0/1 knapsack (subset sum) over at most 168 primes minimising item count, with a suffix DP table driving greedy smallest-first lexicographic reconstruction.
